project.name: Kingsperl Events
project.objective: Modernize Kingsperl Events with legible typography, a vibrant editorial design and an operational customer planning workspace.
project.audience: Event hosts in St. John's and the Avalon Peninsula
project.governing_idea: An architectural K, an event arch and a pearl unify the identity.

creative_system.visual_thesis: Warm ivory, Atlantic green, terracotta and soft botanical colours; clear typography and generous event photography.

palette.contrast: Ivory on ink; gold for meaningful emphasis.

creative_system.composition: Strong single focal point, layered depth, and deliberate negative space.
creative_system.camera: Grounded perspective, motivated movement, and stable screen direction.
creative_system.lighting: Motivated practical sources with consistent direction and softness.
creative_system.typography: Outlined DejaVu Serif wordmark; serif display headings and sans-serif body text.
creative_system.motion: Existing restrained website transitions with reduced-motion support.
creative_system.interface: Clear hierarchy, responsive reflow, keyboard access, and reduced-motion parity.
invariants: Keep approved identity, product geometry, palette roles, and logo treatment consistent.
permitted_variations: Adapt composition and pacing to aspect ratio and placement.

assets.description: Original K, arch and pearl geometry with outlined wordmark.

review_notes: Readable type system with a 14px minimum for supporting interface text and 16–19px controls and body text.
Local-only essential draft saving, secure project-link handoff, checklist, calendar reminder and print summary implemented.
Browser and production verification in progress.

assumptions: Brand scope remains the existing St. John's event-design company.
